definitions.gloss: mastery through experience; learning by doing
definitions.explanation: To truly understand or master something not through study alone but through personal experience and bodily practice. Implies deep, internalized understanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To master a skill through practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{体得|たいとく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are tricks I've learned through years of experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本|ほん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: The best way to learn the basics of cooking is not just from books, but by actually cooking and learning through experience.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Emphasizes that the knowledge or skill has been internalized through practice rather than mere intellectual understanding.

FORMS:
⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ (to gain). Literally 'to gain with the body,' reflecting the idea of embodied learning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to master a technique)
- ⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to learn the knack of something)
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}じて{体得|たいとく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to learn through experience)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習得|しゅうとく}→習得：13903_shuutoku⟧: acquisition of a skill — more general, can include study
- {会得|えとく}: to grasp, to comprehend — focuses on understanding rather than physical mastery
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to acquire, to learn — everyday expression for the same idea
